trials.name: 04_lr_1e-4
trials.note: Slower steps into the regularized basin; more epochs.

trials.name: 05_l2_weaker_1e-4
trials.note: Closer to old 3e-5 L2. Tests if 1e-3 is over-shrinking stars.

trials.name: 06_l2_stronger_5e-3
trials.note: Heavier L2. Expect stabler ranks, more compressed scores.

trials.name: 07_wd_stronger_1e-3
trials.note: Stronger AdamW weight decay (was 1e-4). Pair with 01 (wd=1e-4) and 20 (wd=0).

trials.name: 08_smaller_net_0.5x
trials.note: Half-width net. Fewer equally-good solutions that reorder top-20.

trials.name: 09_old_capacity_1.5x_3layer
trials.note: Pre-option-6 size (1.5x, 3 layers) with CURRENT L2/LR. Isolates capacity vs 15 historic recipe.

trials.name: 11_huber_1.0
trials.note: Tighter Huber (was 1.8). Less influence from huge pp90 outliers.

trials.name: 12_one_hidden_layer
trials.note: Depth 1. Most constrained net - fewest ways to reorder a tight top-20.

trials.name: 13_three_hidden_layers
trials.note: Depth 3 at current width (1x). Historic shape was 3 layers; this isolates depth only.

trials.name: 14_four_hidden_layers
trials.note: Depth 4 at current width. Extra capacity; likely more rank jitter.

trials.name: 15_historic_pre_option6
trials.note: Replay pre-option-6 recipe: 1.5x width, 3 layers, L2=3e-5, AdamW wd=1e-5, lr=1e-3, patience=10/5. Pair with 22_historic_adam.

trials.name: 16_historic_dropout
trials.note: Same historic 3-layer net with the Dropout(0.3)/Dropout(0.1) that used to be commented in.

trials.name: 17_historic_mae_loss
trials.note: Historic comment: MAE "looked to be working quite well if huber does not work out".

trials.name: 18_linear_ridge
trials.note: RidgeCV baseline on the same features/split as the nets. No AdamW, no hidden layers.

trials.name: 19_adam_not_adamw
trials.note: Plain Adam, otherwise 01_baseline HPs (lr=5e-4, l2=1e-3, 2-layer). Pair with 01 (AdamW wd=1e-4) and 20 (AdamW wd=0).

trials.name: 20_adamw_wd_0
trials.note: AdamW with decoupled weight decay off. Same as 01 except wd=0; pair with 19 (Adam) and 07 (wd=1e-3).

trials.name: 21_adam_lr_1e-3
trials.note: Plain Adam at original 1e-3 LR. Pair with 03_lr_1e-3 (AdamW, same LR and other HPs).

trials.name: 22_historic_adam
trials.note: Historic 3-layer recipe with Adam instead of AdamW. Pair with 15_historic_pre_option6.
